name: I-chabod
description: Levite living at the time of United Monarchy

points: Dying, she named the child Ichabod, saying, The glory is departed from Israel: for the ark of God is taken. Remember what the ark contained, the commandments; with the ark gone, she said the glory of Israel was gone. It was a very sad time for the nation of Israel: thirty thousand mighty men lost, Eli dead, and the ark in the hands of the Philistines.

note.label: 1 Samuel 4: The Ark of God Is Taken
